name: Kigali
summary: Kigali is, with data confirming it, one of the safest capitals in Africa: clean streets, strict culture against littering and a well-organized urban center. Its altitude climate (about 1,450 m) is mild and stable throughout the year, without the extreme heat typical of other tropical cities, and it already has real coworkings such as Norrsken House or Impact Hub. The main brake is the digital infrastructure: the average internet speed is behind other nomadic hubs, and being a landlocked country, there is no beach option or weekend coastal getaways.
